description: Runs a raw Search Console performance query: clicks, impressions, CTR and average position, broken down by any mix of query, page, country, device, date, hour and search appearance, with filters. Use it for anything the specialised tools do not cover. Rows come back sorted by clicks unless order_by says otherwise.

aggregation_type.description: How impressions are counted: "byProperty" counts a search once however many of your pages appear, "byPage" counts each page. Leave unset for Google's default.

data_state.description: "all" (default) matches the Search Console website: complete days, plus partial numbers for recent days if the period reaches that far. "final" leaves out any day that is not final yet. "hourly_all" is for the hour dimension.

days.description: Length of the period in days, used when start_date is not given. Default 28.

dimensions.description: How to break the numbers down, in order. Empty returns one row of totals. "searchAppearance" cannot be combined with other dimensions. "hour" needs data_state "hourly_all" and only covers the last few days.

end_date.description: Last day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD in Pacific Time, or "today" / "yesterday". Defaults to the latest day Google has complete data for, usually 3 to 4 days ago. A later date includes days that are still incomplete.

filters.description: Filters; a row must match all of them. Example: [{"dimension":"page","operator":"contains","expression":"/blog/"},{"dimension":"country","operator":"equals","expression":"usa"}]. Countries are ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes, devices are DESKTOP, MOBILE or TABLET, and the regex operators use RE2 syntax.

order.description: Sort direction. Default desc, or asc for position (best first).

order_by.description: Sort by this metric instead of clicks. The tool then reads up to 25,000 rows and sorts them locally, so "top by impressions" is correct within that scan.

row_limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

search_type.description: Which Google surface: web (default), image, video, news (the News tab), discover or googleNews.

site_url.description: Search Console property, for example "sc-domain:example.com" or "https://www.example.com/". A bare domain or any page URL on the site also works. Optional when GSC_SITE_URL is set or the account has exactly one property.

start_date.description: First day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD in Pacific Time. Defaults to `days` before end_date.

start_row.description: Zero-based offset, for paging through results.

name: search_analytics
title: Query search performance data
